name: Fatty acid and eicosanoid metabolism with inherited enzyme defects
rationale: Members cover fatty acid, eicosanoid and 12-lipoxygenase/hepoxilin metabolism and transport, and unlike the eicosanoid-oxidation confusables (EET/HETE, omega-oxidation) they include the inherited CYP and transporter defect diseases (CYP1B1, CYP2U1, CYP7B1, TBXAS1, SLC27A4, SLCO2A1 and others).

qualifier: Golgi mannose trimming and antenna elongation
name: Golgi N-glycan trimming and antenna elongation
rationale: All members describe Golgi processing of N-glycans from Man5 trimming through hybrid/complex synthesis, antenna elongation, poly-LacNAc and sialylation, distinguishing it from O-glycan confusables and from early ER N-glycan processing.

core: Blood pressure and blood volume regulation
name: Renin-angiotensin control of blood pressure and renal sodium excretion
rationale: Members concern angiotensin generation and signaling, kinin/peptide catabolism, cGMP natriuretic signaling and renal sodium, volume and filtration control of blood pressure, distinguishing them from vasodilation-focused confusables and vasopressin/aquaporin water reabsorption.

name: Thyroid hormone and glucocorticoid axis regulation
rationale: Members span thyroid hormone generation, transport and receptor signaling plus ACTH-driven glucocorticoid secretion, response and pregnenolone/progesterone synthesis; the thyroid arm and leptin/growth members separate it from steroid-biosynthesis, GH/prolactin and CRH stress confusables.

name: FLT3 mutant kinase-inhibitor resistance and STAT5 cytokine signaling
rationale: Most members are FLT3 mutant/fusion signaling and drug-resistant FLT3 mutants, with STAT5 and erythropoietin signaling, which distinguishes it from KIT, PDGFR and ALK resistance confusables and from broader erythropoietin signaling.

qualifier: E2F-driven G1/S origin licensing and replication checkpoint
name: E2F-driven G1/S origin licensing and replication checkpoint
rationale: Members cover ORC/CDC6 pre-replicative complex assembly and activation, E2F G1/S transcription and replication-stress ATR checkpoint, which the confusables (DNA unwinding, generic cell cycle, intra-S checkpoint) lack.

name: Plasma cell and B cell immunoglobulin expression signatures
rationale: Nearly all members are naive, memory and plasma B cell surface/immunoglobulin signatures and plasma cell differentiation, contrasting with BCR signaling, B cell proliferation and T cell development confusables; ionomycin response and extrathymic T cell differentiation are minor outliers.

name: Protein quality control via selective autophagy and ERAD
rationale: Members cover misfolded-protein handling through aggrephagy, pexophagy, chaperone-mediated and microautophagy, aggresome formation and ERAD regulation, distinguishing them from proteasomal N-end rule, stress granule, chaperonin folding and ribosome QC confusables.

name: Neuronal apoptotic signaling by dependence receptors and p75NTR
rationale: Members describe death signaling in the absence of ligand (dependence receptors, NTRK3, p75NTR via NRAGE/NADE), neuronal apoptosis and FOXO/CDK5 death programs, unlike the confusables centred on p75NTR survival, NF-kB and neurotrophin processing or anoikis.

qualifier: mitotic and meiotic chromosome segregation machinery
name: Mitotic and meiotic cell cycle progression and chromosome segregation
rationale: Members span E2F/replication licensing, APC/C and PLK1/Aurora control, spindle, cohesion, condensation, nuclear envelope and meiotic recombination/synapsis, which the chromatin, telomere and DNA-damage confusables and the transcription-only cell-cycle confusable lack.

name: Response to organic xenobiotics: dioxin, pesticides, ethanol, nicotine
rationale: Members are responses to organic foreign chemicals (aryl hydrocarbon receptor/TCDD, herbicides, fungicides, insecticides, bisphenol A, genistein, ethanol, nicotine, anesthetics), distinguishing them from metal-ion, vitamin and amine confusables.

name: Intestinal epithelium maintenance and crypt stem cell renewal
rationale: All members describe intestinal epithelial identity, structure and Wnt-driven crypt stem cell homeostasis, distinguishing them from antimicrobial Paneth-cell and HNF4-driven absorptive enterocyte confusables.

core: Membrane channel trafficking and surface localization
name: Connexin trafficking and cell-surface regulation of ion channels
rationale: Members cover connexin oligomerization, transport, gap junction regulation and internalization plus regulation of protein surface localization limiting K+/Ca2+ channel activity, unlike cardiac action potential, nodal clustering and electrical transmission confusables.

qualifier: acrosome reaction and zona pellucida binding
name: Fertilization via acrosome reaction and zona pellucida binding
rationale: All members concern sperm capacitation, acrosome reaction, zona pellucida penetration and egg activation, distinguishing them from germline, sperm motility and maternal-to-zygotic transition confusables.

name: Folate one-carbon metabolism and transport
rationale: Members center on folate/tetrahydrofolate metabolism, formate and pterin turnover, folate transport and folate-linked tube closure, separating them from methionine/SAM, cobalamin and other B-vitamin confusables.

name: AU-rich element binding protein control of mRNA stability
rationale: Members are 3'-UTR AU-rich element binding proteins (HuR, TTP, BRF1, KSRP, AUF1) that stabilize or destabilize mRNA, unlike stress granule, miRNA silencing, translational silencing and decapping confusables.

name: Replicative and base excision repair DNA synthesis
rationale: Members cover primer synthesis, polymerase switching, strand elongation and flap removal in replication and telomere C-strand synthesis plus long-patch and single-nucleotide base excision repair synthesis, distinguishing them from translesion synthesis and nucleotide excision repair confusables.

qualifier: G-beta-gamma gating of potassium and calcium channels
name: G-beta-gamma presynaptic inhibition via potassium and calcium channels
rationale: All members describe G protein beta-gamma activation of GIRK channels, inhibition of voltage-gated Ca2+ channels and presynaptic kainate modulation of membrane potential, unlike confusables on vesicle exocytosis and transmitter secretion.

name: RUNX transcriptional control of granulocytic myeloid differentiation
rationale: Members combine RUNX1/2/3 target-gene programs with granulopoiesis, G-CSF signaling and neutrophil/eosinophil differentiation, which distinguishes them from macrophage/monocyte, HSC and promyelocyte confusables.

qualifier: viral budding, abscission and nuclear envelope sealing
name: ESCRT-mediated membrane fission in budding, abscission and nuclear sealing
rationale: Members are ESCRT-dependent fission events: HIV/viral budding, MVB and exosome formation, midbody abscission and nuclear envelope resealing, unlike cytokinesis-ring, endocytic sorting and nuclear lamina confusables.

name: Th2-driven eosinophil activation and recruitment
rationale: Members link Th2 differentiation and IL-5 production to eosinophil activation, chemotaxis and mast cell activation, distinguishing them from granulocyte differentiation and IL-4/IL-13/IL-33 confusables.

name: Cardiac chamber myocardium and ventricular septum morphogenesis
rationale: All members describe ventricular and atrial myocardium development (trabeculae, compact myocardium), and only this theme includes membranous and muscular septum morphogenesis.

name: Oncogene- and stress-induced senescence via CDKN2A and p53
rationale: Members cover oncogene-, oxidative- and replicative senescence, p16INK4A/p14ARF evasion, p53-p21 G1 arrest, SAHF, SASP and Polycomb silencing, unlike p53 DNA-damage and apoptosis confusables.

name: Nuclear export of mature mRNA
rationale: All members describe export of mature mRNAs (intron-containing, intronless, SLBP-dependent/independent) from the nucleus, unlike mRNA 3'-end processing, nuclear pore assembly and Rev-mediated transport confusables.

name: Inherited TLR3-TRIF-TRAF3 deficiencies in herpes simplex encephalitis
rationale: All three members are TLR3-pathway gene deficiencies causing herpes simplex encephalitis, distinguishing them from IRF3/RIG-I, endosomal TLR7-9 and TAK1 signaling confusables.
